title: Pull Copilot usage via Microsoft Graph reports API
problem: You want Copilot usage in Power BI or a scheduled report.
steps: Grant Reports.Read.All (application, or delegated for a user with e.g. Reports Reader or AI Administrator).

Call `GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/copilot/reports/getMicrosoft365CopilotUsageUserDetail(period='D28')` (also UserCountSummary and UserCountTrend). The default report version is v2, which accepts D7, D28, D90, D180 and ALL; D30 is only valid with `version='v1'`. v1.0 returns a CSV stream, beta returns JSON.
Schedule with Azure Automation or a Logic App and store the results.
pitfalls: The API only covers users with a Copilot license — unlicensed Copilot Chat usage isn't in Graph reports; use the admin center Copilot Chat report or the audit log.
Usernames are concealed unless the reports privacy setting is changed.
Copying older examples with period='D30' against the default v2 report: use D28, or request version='v1' explicitly if you need the v1 column set.
Delegated calls also need the signed-in user in a report-reading role (for example Reports Reader or AI Administrator) — the Graph permission alone is not enough.
done_when: A scheduled job calls the Copilot usage report API with Reports.Read.All and stores the results where Power BI (or your report) can read them.
